name: Oshidori International Holdings Limited
summary: Oshidori International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides financial services in Hong Kong. It operates through Financial Services, Tactical and/or Strategical Investments, and Credit and Lending Services segments. The company engages in provision of securities brokerage, margin financing, placing and underwriting, investment advisory, asset management, advising on securities, futures contracts, and corporate finance advisory services, as well as engages in trading and investing securities.
